s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic abdominal discomfort with worsening diarrhea and generalized weakness
salient_findings: Green-brown slimy stools multiple times per day
Diffuse colonic wall thickening with pericolonic stranding on abdominal CT
Intensely fludeoxyglucose-avid focus in the left anterior pelvis on PET scan
key_facts: Last colonoscopy at age 80 was unremarkable
Hospitalized for rectal bleeding 9 months earlier
Abdominal CT showed left-sided colitis and possible diverticulitis
PET scan showed intensely fludeoxyglucose-avid focus in the left anterior pelvis
Experienced functional decline 2 months before admission
Stool tests for bacterial culture, PCR, Clostridioides difficile, ova and parasites, and leukocytes were negative

shortlist.label: Colorectal cancer
shortlist.why_kept: PET scan showed intensely fludeoxyglucose-avid focus in the left anterior pelvis, strongly suspicious for malignancy

shortlist.label: Ulcerative colitis
shortlist.why_kept: Diffuse colonic wall thickening with pericolonic stranding on abdominal CT, suggesting extensive inflammation

shortlist.label: Diverticulitis
shortlist.why_kept: Previous abdominal CT showed possible diverticulitis and patient has history of rectal bleeding

shortlist.label: Crohn's disease
shortlist.why_kept: Patient presents with chronic abdominal discomfort, worsening diarrhea, and generalized weakness, consistent with inflammatory bowel disease

shortlist.label: Ischemic colitis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient's age and history of hyperlipidemia increase risk for ischemic colitis, and abdominal CT shows diffuse colonic wall thickening

raw.rationale: The patient's history of rectal bleeding, left-sided colitis, and a PET scan showing an intensely fludeoxyglucose-avid focus in the left anterior pelvis, strongly suspicious for malignancy, along with the presence of diffuse colonic wall thickening and pericolonic stranding on abdominal CT, support the diagnosis of colorectal cancer.

rejected.label: Ulcerative colitis
rejected.why: While the patient has colitis, the presence of a mass and the PET scan findings are more suggestive of malignancy than inflammatory bowel disease.

rejected.label: Diverticulitis
rejected.why: The patient's symptoms and imaging findings are not limited to the area of the colon typically affected by diverticulitis, and the PET scan findings suggest a more sinister process.

rejected.label: Crohn's disease
rejected.why: The patient's age and lack of prior diagnosis of Crohn's disease make this less likely, and the imaging findings are more suggestive of a malignant process.

rejected.label: Ischemic colitis
rejected.why: The patient's symptoms and imaging findings do not suggest an acute ischemic event, and the presence of a mass and the PET scan findings are more suggestive of malignancy.
